20-033.r: State Advocate General → appointed by Governor, not President; speaks in State Legislature, no vote (Art 177). Advisory jurisdiction → Supreme Court (Art 143), not High Courts.

27-113.r: V.R. Krishna Iyer → SC judge, never Chief Justice of India; with P.N. Bhagwati, pioneer of PIL (Public Interest Litigation), which lies in both High Courts and Supreme Court.
27-113.t: PIL = Public Interest Litigation, not Public Inquiry or Public Investment Litigation.

29-070.r: Art 173: legislator must be citizen, twenty-five+ (Assembly)/thirty+ (Council), so voter eligibility alone can't make one minister; RPA 1951: two+ years' jail → disqualified till six years after release.
29-070.t: The six-year bar runs from release; it is not a permanent disqualification.
hi: Representation of the People Act (लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम)

29-082.r: Chief Secretary → chosen by Chief Minister, appointed by Governor; head of the State's administrative machinery; has no fixed tenure.

30-040.r: Judicial custody → accused in Magistrate's custody, kept in jail (police custody = police lockup); police may interrogate only with court's approval. Arrested person goes before Magistrate within 24 hours.

43-058.r: Commonwealth → has no charter, treaty or constitution; ex-British territories did not join automatically, a country must declare it (Burma, Egypt, Kuwait, UAE never joined).
